description_en: Invoke DescribeFaultDiagnosisOverallData to obtain the overview data for abnormal diagnosis.
description_zh: 调用DescribeFaultDiagnosisOverallData获取异常诊断的概览数据
name: DescribeFaultDiagnosisOverallData

parameters.help_en: Start Time of the query, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_ts

parameters.help_en: End Time of the query, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: end_ts

parameters.help_en:
Dimension for Data Statistics. Valid values:
JOIN_SLOW_USER: User Count with slow channel joining.
AUDIO_STUCK_USER: User Count experiencing Audio stuttering.
VIDEO_STUCK_USER: User Count experiencing Video stuttering.
VIDEO_VAGUE_USER: User Count experiencing Video blur.
HIGH_DELAY_USER: User Count with high call latency.
FIRST_FRAME_SLOW_USER: User Count with slow first-frame reception
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据统计维度。取值：
JOIN_SLOW_USER：进频道慢用户数。
AUDIO_STUCK_USER：音频卡顿用户数。
VIDEO_STUCK_USER：视频卡顿用户数。
VIDEO_VAGUE_USER：视频模糊用户数。
HIGH_DELAY_USER：通话延迟高用户数。
FIRST_FRAME_SLOW_USER：接收首屏慢用户数
parameters.name: stat_dim
